misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:74 - Guessing the English file name crashes the verifier when no matching `_en` file exists.. The English file path is built by replacing `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties` with `_en.properties`. A bundle whose base name contains an underscore and has no locale, such as the old fixture `duplicate_keys.properties` (which had to be renamed), maps to a file that does not exist (`duplicate_en.properties`). The same happens for any theme with no English counterpart at the derived path. In those cases the code throws an unchecked `RuntimeException` that aborts the whole Maven run, and it is not reported as a `MojoExecutionException` or as a message. Handle a missing English bundle gracefully, for example by treating the English text as empty or adding a message, and throw `MojoExecutionException` for read errors.
